description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Template' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Template' namespace. The class provides methods for managing template paths, rendering templates with data, and compiling templates into PHP files, specifically used within the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class responsible for managing template rendering, path management, and compilation in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace-to-directory mapping to the template path configurations.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with provided data, returning the resulting HTML as a string.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a template source into a cached PHP file for efficient re-use.
